meta.title: Canadian Municipal DCC rates — Day 1 extraction (Surrey BC, Victoria BC)
notes: Surrey operative bylaw is Development Cost Charge Bylaw, 2024, No. 21174 (effective 2024-05-15). A 2026 DCC bylaw was approved by Council for provincial submission (May 2026) but was still awaiting provincial approval / final adoption as of extraction; proposed 2026 rates are NOT included.

Victoria operative bylaw is Development Cost Charges Bylaw No. 24-053 (adopted 2024-11-14). Source PDF retrieved via Wayback Machine snapshot (2025-08-29) of the official victoria.ca media URL because live download is bot-protected from this environment.

City of Victoria Guide to Building Permit Fees lists slightly higher DCC amounts than Schedule A (e.g. low-density $25,149.91 vs $24,582.06). No adopted CPI amendment bylaw was located during Day 1; Schedule A values are used and fee-guide amounts are omitted.
